title: How Copyright Frameworks Influence AI Competitiveness
gist: Oxford Economics benchmarks copyright regimes across seven APAC countries and finds that clearer, more flexible copyright frameworks that don't constrain AI training correlate with stronger AI ecosystem performance, especially in R&D. Legal certainty plus strong ecosystem fundamentals (infrastructure, talent, investment) position countries to capture AI's economic upside; restrictive or uncertain regimes risk deterring investment and widening the gap between AI leaders and laggards.
